requirements.requirement_text: EUBAM Libya shall contribute to enhancing the capacity of the relevant Libyan authorities and agencies to manage Libya's borders, to fight cross-border crime, including human trafficking and migrant smuggling, and to counter terrorism.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: EUBAM Libya shall support the Libyan authorities and agencies responsible for border management, including in facilitating intra-agency, inter-agency and international cooperation as guiding principles of integrated border management.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: EUBAM Libya shall support the Libyan authorities and agencies involved in the fight against cross-border crime, including human trafficking and migrant smuggling, and against terrorism, in line with international standards in these areas.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: EUBAM Libya shall facilitate and support cooperation and interoperability of the Libyan authorities and agencies in these thematic areas in order to help them mitigate possible gaps or overlaps in border management, address cross-border crime, including human trafficking and migrant smuggling, and counter terrorism.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: EUBAM Libya shall provide specific needs assessments and develop related projects in support of the Mission's operational activities.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: EUBAM Libya shall provide technical advice, capacity building activities at the operational and technical levels and shall carry out projects, complemented as appropriate and on a case-by-case basis by specialised training. EUBAM Libya shall furthermore provide strategic advice where requested by the Libyan authorities.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: The financial reference amount intended to cover the expenditure of EUBAM Libya from 1 October 2023 until 30 June 2025 shall be decided by the Council.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: A strategic assessment of EUBAM Libya and its mandate shall be conducted by the PSC by 30 June 2024.
requirements.law_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/1305 of 26 June 2023 amending Decision 2013/233/CFSP on the European Union Integrated Border Management Assistance Mission in Libya (EUBAM Libya)

requirements.requirement_text: A strategic review of EUBAM Libya shall be conducted in good time before the expiry of this Decision.

requirements.requirement_text: Decisions on all applications for international protection must be taken on the basis of the facts and, in the first instance, by authorities whose personnel has the appropriate knowledge or has received the necessary training in the field of international protection
requirements.law_title: Directive 2013/32/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013 on common procedures for granting and withdrawing international protection (recast)

requirements.requirement_text: Professionals acting in the framework of the procedures provided for in this Directive must perform their activities with due respect for the applicable deontological principles
requirements.law_title: Directive 2013/32/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013 on common procedures for granting and withdrawing international protection (recast)

requirements.requirement_text: Applicants should be provided at first instance, free of charge, with legal and procedural information, taking into account their particular circumstances
requirements.law_title: Directive 2013/32/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013 on common procedures for granting and withdrawing international protection (recast)

requirements.requirement_text: In appeals procedures, subject to certain conditions, applicants should be granted free legal assistance and representation provided by persons competent to provide them under national law
requirements.law_title: Directive 2013/32/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013 on common procedures for granting and withdrawing international protection (recast)

requirements.requirement_text: The procedure in which an application for international protection is examined should normally provide an applicant at least with: the right to stay pending a decision by the determining authority; access to the services of an interpreter for submitting his or her case if interviewed by the authorities; the opportunity to communicate with a representative of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) and with organisations providing advice or counselling to applicants for international protection; the right to appropriate notification of a decision and of the reasons for that decision in fact and in law; the opportunity to consult a legal adviser or other counsellor; the right to be informed of his or her legal position at decisive moments in the course of the procedure, in a language which he or she understands or is reasonably supposed to understand; and, in the case of a negative decision, the right to an effective remedy before a court or a tribunal
requirements.law_title: Directive 2013/32/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013 on common procedures for granting and withdrawing international protection (recast)

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall take the necessary steps to establish an obligation for carriers to transmit at the request of the authorities responsible for carrying out checks on persons at external borders, by the end of check-in, information concerning the passengers they will carry to an authorised border crossing point through which these persons will enter the territory of a Member State.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Carriers must transmit passenger information at the request of border authorities by the end of check-in
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall take the necessary measures to impose sanctions on carriers which, as a result of fault, have not transmitted data or have transmitted incomplete or false data.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall take the necessary measures to ensure that sanctions are dissuasive, effective and proportionate with maximum amount not less than EUR 5000 or minimum amount not less than EUR 3000 for each journey for which passenger data were not communicated or were communicated incorrectly.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall ensure that their laws, regulations and administrative provisions stipulate that carriers against which proceedings are brought with a view to imposing penalties have effective rights of defence and appeal.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall ensure that these data are collected by the carriers and transmitted electronically or, in case of failure, by any other appropriate means to the authorities responsible for carrying out border checks.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: The authorities responsible for carrying out checks on persons at external borders shall save the data in a temporary file.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: After passengers have entered, these authorities shall delete the data, within 24 hours after transmission, unless the data are needed later for the purposes of exercising the statutory functions of the authorities responsible for carrying out checks on persons at external borders in accordance with national law and subject to data protection provisions under Directive 95/46/EC.
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall take the necessary measures to oblige carriers to delete, within 24 hours of the arrival of the means of transportation pursuant to Article 3(1), the personal data they have collected and transmitted to the border authorities for the purposes of this Directive.
requirements.deadline_text: within 24 hours of the arrival of the means of transportation
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/82/EC of 29 April 2004 on the obligation of carriers to communicate passenger data

requirements.requirement_text: Carriers must delete personal data within 24 hours of the arrival of the means of transportation

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall give effect to the provision of this Directive without discrimination on the basis of sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic characteristics, language, religion or belief, political or other opinions, membership of a national minority, fortune, birth, disabilities, age or sexual orientation
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/81/EC of 29 April 2004 on the residence permit issued to third-country nationals who are victims of trafficking in human beings or who have been the subject of an action to facilitate illegal immigration, who cooperate with the competent authorities

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall apply this Directive to the third-country nationals who are, or have been victims of offences related to the trafficking in human beings, even if they have illegally entered the territory of the Member States
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/81/EC of 29 April 2004 on the residence permit issued to third-country nationals who are victims of trafficking in human beings or who have been the subject of an action to facilitate illegal immigration, who cooperate with the competent authorities

requirements.requirement_text: When the competent authorities of the Member States take the view that a third-country national may fall into the scope of this Directive, they shall inform the person concerned of the possibilities offered under this Directive
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/81/EC of 29 April 2004 on the residence permit issued to third-country nationals who are victims of trafficking in human beings or who have been the subject of an action to facilitate illegal immigration, who cooperate with the competent authorities

requirements.requirement_text: Member States shall ensure that the third-country nationals concerned are granted a reflection period allowing them to recover and escape the influence of the perpetrators of the offences so that they can take an informed decision as to whether to cooperate with the competent authorities
requirements.law_title: Council Directive 2004/81/EC of 29 April 2004 on the residence permit issued to third-country nationals who are victims of trafficking in human beings or who have been the subject of an action to facilitate illegal immigration, who cooperate with the competent authorities
